name: bld5_prime_dvd_lucas_four_mul_mod_eight
statement: (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hd : p ∣ p3_lucas (4 * n)) : p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 7
closed: ∀ (p n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) (hd : p ∣ p3_lucas (4 * n)), p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 7
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_lucas_sq_sub_five_fib_sq and Mathlib2.lib_p3_lucas_cast: first the duplication formula L_{2m} = L_m² − 2(−1)^m in ℤ (from lib_p3_lucas_cast, Nat.fib_two_mul, Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one, giving 2L_{2m} = L_m² + 5F_m², then the bld2 identity L_m² − 5F_m² = 4(−1)^m). With m = 2n: L_{4n} = L_{2n}² − 2, so p ∣ L_{4n} makes 2 a square in ZMod p, and ZMod.exists_sq_eq_two_iff (p ≠ 2) gives p ≡ ±1 mod 8.
type: ∀ (p n : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ≠ 2 → p ∣ Mathlib2.p3_lucas (4 * n) → p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 7
